### Add-on services

Declare extra Compose services in `supbuddy.addons.yml` (or a `docker-compose.override.yml`); Supbuddy merges and runs them alongside the stack on the shared Compose network. Scaffold a starter file with the `scaffold_addons` MCP tool, and tail a service with `tail_service_logs`. An optional `x-supbuddy.seed` step runs once after the services are healthy (`seed_addons` to re-run). Edit `supbuddy.addons.yml` directly — don't hand-edit the merged `-f` command Supbuddy builds.
